# Native source provenance

The Android build vendors a subset of ZeroTier One 1.16.2 from [upstream](https://github.com/zerotier/ZeroTierOne/tree/fe29cd88886e4f58547ba7f740b2d73eb49ab222). It includes the core, headers, OS support, Java JNI bindings, and the HTTP Parser, nlohmann JSON and prometheus-cpp-lite dependencies used by the ARM builds. The core carries the included MPL 2.0 license. Refer to file headers and included license texts for JNI and third-party terms.
